description: Ask Codex (OpenAI) to act as the planner: produce an implementation plan, review a design, or give a second opinion. Codex runs in a READ-ONLY sandbox in `cwd` and can inspect the project but not change it. Claude remains the implementer. Calls can take several minutes; use background=true to keep working meanwhile. Including relevant code/diffs in `context` makes it faster. Returns Codex's answer, a job_id and a session_id; pass session_id back to ask follow-ups in the same Codex thread.

background.description: Optional. true = return a job_id immediately and keep working; collect the result later with codex_result. Default false (wait for the answer).

context.description: Optional extra context: relevant diffs, error output, decisions already made.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the project directory Codex should inspect.

effort.description: Optional reasoning effort. Default: the user's Codex config (high). Use medium/low for quick questions; xhigh/max for hard architecture problems.

model.description: Optional Codex model override. Default: the user's Codex config.

request.description: What to plan or review. Include goals, constraints and acceptance criteria.

session_id.description: Optional. Continue an earlier Codex thread instead of starting fresh.

name: codex_plan
